name: Amber Fort
description: A majestic hilltop fort known for its artistic Hindu style elements and panoramic views of Maota Lake.

name: Jal Mahal
description: A stunning palace situated in the middle of Man Sagar Lake, offering picturesque views and photo opportunities.

name: Panna Meena ka Kund
description: An ancient stepwell with symmetrical staircases and intricate architecture, perfect for history buffs and photographers.

name: Shila Devi Temple
description: A sacred temple dedicated to Goddess Shila Devi, known for its religious significance and beautiful carvings.

name: Jaigarh Fort
description: A massive fort overlooking Amber Fort, famous for its cannon foundry and panoramic views of the Aravalli hills.

name: Nahargarh Fort
description: A fort offering stunning sunset views over Jaipur city and a blend of Indian and European architectural styles.

name: Amber Village Market
description: A bustling local market where visitors can shop for traditional Rajasthani handicrafts, textiles, and jewelry.

name: Elephant Rides at Amber Fort
description: A unique experience riding elephants up the hill to Amber Fort, offering a royal and traditional journey.

name: Maota Lake
description: A serene lake at the base of Amber Fort, ideal for peaceful walks and spotting migratory birds during winter.

name: Sisodia Rani Garden
description: A beautifully landscaped garden with fountains, murals, and pavilions, showcasing royal Mughal garden design.

name: Anokhi Museum of Hand Printing
description: A museum dedicated to the art of traditional hand block printing, featuring workshops and exhibits.

name: Galta Ji Temple
description: A historic Hindu pilgrimage site with natural springs, sacred water tanks, and ancient temples set in a rocky landscape.

name: Amber Light and Sound Show
description: An evening show narrating the history of Amber Fort with dramatic lights and sound effects.

name: Jaipur Ropeway (Nahargarh Biological Park)
description: A scenic cable car ride offering breathtaking views of the Aravalli hills and the Nahargarh Biological Park.

name: Chand Baori Stepwell
description: A hidden stepwell near Amber Fort with intricate geometric steps and a cool retreat from the heat.

name: Rajputana Handicrafts Workshop
description: A local workshop where visitors can watch artisans create traditional Rajasthani crafts and try their hand at it.

name: Amber Fort Photography Tour
description: A guided early morning photography tour capturing the fort’s architecture and sunrise views without crowds.

name: Local Rajasthani Cuisine Experience
description: Enjoy authentic Rajasthani dishes in a traditional setting with local hosts sharing culinary stories.

name: Amber Fort Sound and Light Show
description: An immersive evening show that brings the history of Amber Fort alive through narration and lighting effects.

name: Stepwell Meditation Spot
description: A quiet, lesser-known stepwell area perfect for meditation and peaceful reflection away from tourist crowds.
